summary_en: Soiken Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 1.5 million shares (5.73% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 300 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13, 2026 to May 31, 2027, targeting capital efficiency and strategic reserve for M&A and employee equity compensation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Soiken Holdings' board of directors approved a new share buyback program authorizing the acquisition of up to 1.5 million shares of common stock, representing 5.73% of outstanding shares (26.158 million shares excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum total consideration of 300 million yen. The purchases will be executed through open market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement, with the acquisition period running from November 13, 2026 through May 31, 2027. The maximum price per share implied by the aggregate authorization is 200 yen.

The company stated that the buyback aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business circumstances. The acquired treasury shares will be held for potential deployment in future M&A transactions and capital partnerships, with a portion also earmarked for employee equity compensation programs. Management indicated these shares will be deployed strategically to support business growth and enhance corporate value.
